required_outcomes: Records the landlord's reply at event 015 as his decision for this property: the agency may send its own contractor for the bedroom window at Flat 24, 150 Copperfield Walk.

Gets a contractor instructed for the bedroom window only (assigns a provider, or returns the ticket to provider selection when no contractor is on file), asking them to contact the tenant to arrange a visit.
Tells the tenant (Eliza Jenkins) that the landlord has agreed and a contractor will be in touch to arrange a visit, without inventing a date.
acceptable_alternatives: Sending the landlord a short acknowledgement that a contractor is being arranged.
Setting a follow-up for the contractor to confirm a visit date.
positive_behaviours: Notes in the case record that the earlier Flat 18, 88 Alder Lane email related to a different property and is closed off.
Keeps the job description to the window only, as the toilet was fixed by the tenant.
red_flags: Asking the landlord again whether he wants his own contractor or the agency’s.
Escalating to a human or leaving the case on hold for the landlord when his decision is clear.
Mentioning the toilet as part of the job sent to the contractor.
prohibited_actions: Sending any message that gives Flat 18, 88 Alder Lane as the job address.
critical_failures: Ending the turn with no contractor instructed and the ticket not returned to provider selection, either by escalating or by re-asking the landlord.
